title: GatewayRefusedEvent
description: One of the run's sandbox gateways refused a request (SEC2 O-2): the egress proxy (a destination, a path, a credential or a body it will not forward) or the model gateway (a parameter, a model, a budget or a body it will not serve). The gateway reports it with the run's own gateway token; Node writes it on the run's stream, once per run, gateway and reason, and at most a fixed number per run. Ids and reason codes only: never the request's content, URL path or query. Tool-gateway refusals are `tool.denied`. Folds ignore it; it is an audit record.

gateway.description: egress: the sandbox's egress proxy; model: the model gateway.

reason.description: The gateway's reason code (its refusal registry, C-6).

status.description: The HTTP status the gateway answered.

host.description: The destination host the egress proxy refused, where it logs one; never a path or query.

param.description: The request field the model gateway named in its refusal, as a dotted path; never its value.

attemptId.description: The attempt the reporting token was issued for, from the verified token.
